hook_formula: Instant absurd transformation hook (witch curses crush into a 90yo grandma with a walker at school), pairing immediate visual contradiction with high-stakes teenage romance.
story_arc: Setup: Crush is cursed into an elderly woman struggling through normal school routines. Escalation: Hero discovers brave acts subtract one year of age and sets up stunts. Payoff: Stunts are too slow, so hero takes the ultimate brave risk by asking her out, breaking the curse instantly.

visual_style.background_details: Red metal lockers, modular school desks, outdoor track fences, brick school facades, suburban houses, cafeteria trays, and event posters.

character_archetypes.outfit_style: striped long-sleeve sweater and dark trousers

character_archetypes.hair_style: long with bangs (white-grey aged, black young)
character_archetypes.outfit_style: prep school blazer, necktie, pleated skirt, thigh-high socks
varsity jacket over white tee and jeans
dark magical robes with purple trim

visual_style.character_interactions: Close two-shots maintaining 1-2 block grid spacing; grandma character hunching behind a silver walker frame; props passed hand-to-hand with sudden snap poses.

source_transcript: A witch turned my crush into a grandma. She still had to come to school. I liked her since first grade. She has no idea. She was 90 and she still had to take the math test. The teacher started calling her ma'am. She ran the mile in gym with a walker. She finished on Thursday. She fell asleep in every class and once in her suit. Then the bully called her grandma. She hit him with a purse. The next morning she looked a year younger. That night I figured it out. Every time she does something brave she gets a year younger. So I made her brave. I took her on the biggest rollercoaster in the state. 88. I signed her up to sing at the school assembly. 87. She told the lunch lady the meatloaf tasted like feet. 86. She skateboarded down the steepest hill in town. 85. At this rate she'd be young again in 70 years. So I did the bravest thing I've ever done. I asked her to the dance. She said yes and was young again in one second.
